name: Blitzwolfer
abilities: Sonic howl from a four-way splitting muzzle (green concussive blasts)
Sonic redirection of projectiles / sonic propulsion
weaknesses: Cannot howl if his muzzle is forced shut (bandages, muzzle covers)
Sensitive hearing - loud noises like giant bells overwhelm him
Can be controlled by Vladat Corrupturas
Can be scared by Toepick's species
summary: Ben's werewolf: a grey Loboan whose muzzle splits four ways to unleash shattering sonic howls, first gained when the Yenaldooshi's DNA half-transformed him.
traits: Originally named Benwolf; renamed Blitzwolfer in Omniverse
Ben transformed gradually over the course of Benwolf
notableFeats: Pursued the Werewolf and saved Max and Wes from a lava flow (Benwolf)
Fought the Red Knight atop Big Ben and saved Kai (An American Benwolf in London)
Chased Nyancy Chan up a giant yarn ball (Catfight)
Defeated a Jungle Guardian and uncovered the Temple of the Sky (The Secret of Dos Santos)

appearances.designNotes: Grey fur, three furry tendrils, bushy tail, three claws per hand/foot, green mouth interior, spiked elbows/shoulders, white jumpsuit with black stripes, original Omnitrix on the lower stomach. Ben transformed in three stages during the episode.

More muscular; green suit, collar and wristbands, four claws, a long flowing mane instead of tendrils, green tongue, white belt, Omnitrix on the collar. (11-year-old design: white suit with black stripes - described but not used on-screen.)

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox OV image; the wiki file '20298.png' redirects to 'Wolfy.png' (same render).

scoring.rationale: Fast, agile brawler with a genuinely dangerous ranged sonic howl and lava/Corrodium immunity, but limited defence and a howl that is silenced by anything clamping his muzzle.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
OV Season 6 heading in the extract corresponds to Catfight.
Only OS episode is Benwolf; DNA donor is the Yenaldooshi (Werewolf).
